recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Future changes to Meta.lastUpdated should proceed under later focused issues such as FHIR-45047 or successors, not by reverting to FHIR-40260's older exact replacement sentence.
issue_request: FHIR-40260 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core BaseResource issue asking to resolve inconsistent Meta.lastUpdated guidance by replacing the old comment that the value is always populated except when the resource is first being created with wording that submitted PUT/POST instances generally omit the element and servers populate it in response or retrieval instances.
initial_application: Commit 8d6fa98e95dcd157c81158a0711e4fd7d21fe246 applied FHIR-40260 in source/datatypes/meta.xml by removing the old 'always populated except' phrase and inserting the voted PUT/POST and response/GET wording. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-40260 was present on the combined branch before this reconciliation.
additional_context: Meta is an active normative datatype in source/fhir.ini. Later same-element work, especially FHIR-45047 and its existing reconciliation commit 6f66087a127ae4cca2ec41ad6e5acddb02ce8421, refined the Meta.lastUpdated comment to say the server might populate it when data is received or when crafting a response instance and to describe out-of-sync scenarios. That later wording supersedes the exact 2023 replacement text while preserving the FHIR-40260 clarification. The Resource metadata REST narrative remains consistent because the current element comment no longer says lastUpdated must already be populated in create submissions.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source edit was needed because the current authoritative Meta.lastUpdated row already removes the inconsistent phrase and contains the approved server-population guidance.
